title: Syracuse Common Council votes to shut down Westcott Theater
summary: The Syracuse Common Council voted unanimously to rescind the Westcott Theater's special use permit, effectively closing the 18-year-old entertainment venue. This land-use and permitting decision reflects council action on a significant cultural/commercial asset in the city.

political_signal.description: Unanimous council vote to revoke operating permit suggests formal compliance or enforcement action; warrants investigation into underlying code violations or complaints that triggered this decision.

processing_notes: Article lacks underlying reason for permit revocation—no violations, complaints, or justification detailed; CIO should request complaint/code-enforcement records and investigation file for full context.
